topics.title: Actuarial Modeling of Annuity-Based Life Insurance Products
topics.summary: Actuarial modeling and implementation of a life insurance product with annuity-based benefits, combining pricing, reserve calculations, and dynamic contract updates into a numerically consistent production model.
topics.keyContribution: Corrected inconsistent mortality-based pricing logic, stabilized inverse premium/benefit calculations, and designed a recalculation framework that kept pricing and reserve relationships consistent under mid-term contract changes.

topics.title: Dynamic Actuarial Functions under Time-Dependent Policy Behavior
topics.summary: Actuarial reconstruction and implementation of a life insurance model with time-dependent policy behavior, where mortality selection, lapse assumptions, pricing, and reserve logic had to be combined into a recursive computational framework.
topics.keyContribution: Reformulated a spreadsheet-defined insurance model into reusable recursive actuarial functions, enabling consistent pricing and reserving under year-specific lapse behavior and later mid-term contract changes.

topics.title: Decomposition of Actuarial Functions under Piecewise Mortality Assumptions
topics.summary: Actuarial analysis of life insurance functions under piecewise-defined mortality assumptions, enabling decomposition of pricing and reserve formulas into segments with different mortality regimes.
topics.keyContribution: Derived a decomposition framework that splits actuarial quantities across time intervals with distinct mortality assumptions, allowing consistent pricing and reserving even when mortality inputs change discretely over time.

topics.title: Integration of Rider Premiums and Benefits in Multi-Component Life Insurance Models
topics.summary: Actuarial modeling of multi-component life insurance products with additional riders, focusing on consistent integration of rider premiums and benefits into the base contract pricing and reserve framework.
topics.keyContribution: Designed a unified modeling approach that integrates rider components into core actuarial calculations, ensuring consistency of premiums, benefits, and reserves across combined product structures.

topics.title: Surrender Value and Paid-Up Policy Consistency
topics.summary: Actuarial analysis of surrender values and paid-up policies, focusing on maintaining consistency between reserve-based valuations and contract transformations under early termination or premium cessation.
topics.keyContribution: Established a consistent framework linking surrender value and paid-up benefit calculations to underlying reserve definitions, ensuring actuarial and numerical coherence across contract state transitions.

topics.title: Premium Calibration under Fixed Benefit Structures
topics.summary: Actuarial calibration of premium levels for life insurance contracts with fixed benefits, focusing on solving inverse pricing problems under given benefit structures and mortality assumptions.
topics.keyContribution: Developed a stable inverse pricing framework that determines premium levels consistent with predefined benefits, ensuring alignment between pricing inputs, actuarial assumptions, and resulting reserve dynamics.

topics.title: Reinsurance Exposure Allocation
topics.summary: Actuarial modeling of reinsurance exposure allocation, focusing on how risk and cash flows are distributed between insurer and reinsurer under different contract structures.
topics.keyContribution: Formulated a consistent allocation framework that maps underlying policy cash flows and risk measures to reinsurance structures, enabling transparent and numerically stable distribution of exposure between parties.
